Type: unknown
Size: 20 files, ~427 LOC

## Stack
backend: Python app

## Missing
- [high] Test suite: Automated tests reduce risk on every change.
- [medium] CI workflow: CI gates merges with build, lint, and test runs on every PR.
- [medium] .env.example: Documents required env vars.
- [medium] SECURITY.md: A published security policy gives a defined disclosure path.
- [low] Dockerfile: Reproducible local and production environments.
- [low] LICENSE: License file makes the legal status of the code unambiguous.

## Risks
- [high] No published security policy: Without SECURITY.md, vulnerability disclosure has no defined path.
- [medium] Environment contract undocumented: Missing .env.example invites secrets being hard-coded or committed by accident.
- [high] No automated test surface: Any AI-generated or manual change ships unverified.
